rationale: Test egg/carrot sale timing as one isolated extension of the required three-product guard. The earlier all-items estimate also included tomato and melon, so it does not prove this change. The 09-13 reference model is fixed; score is not probability.

Completed oracle-off tests favored 7000: replays 36-31 to 38-29; substitute live opponents on lost seeds 51-11 to 55-7. The 6000 gate worsened both records, so do not queue it. But ladder1 iteration 88 (the Aspen line without the predictor, 747 games) rejected 7000: 49 games better, 36 worse, +$87 a game (p=0.19), results +16/-16. Test the interaction with the required predictor. This changes zero-to-ten investment only, not Ichika-style 10-to-18 route capacity.
